entries.pattern: Laws of Coding|Laws of Computation|Laws of Programming Languages|Laws of Programming|layers of law|layer of law|axioms of motion|physical law|equation of motion
entries.note: The RCE-JEPA proposal 'Laws of Coding', framed as conjecture in the RCE-JEPA thesis; 'axioms of motion' and 'equation of motion' refer to Newton as history. 'Laws of Computation' is framed as an open problem, not yet formalized. Four distinct named layers: "Laws of Computation", "Laws of Programming Languages", "Laws of Programming" (Hoare et al. 1987), "Laws of Coding".
